mentions.name: Checktica
mentions.description: An API that provides heuristic signals about whether a piece of text is likely LLM-generated. It uses an ensemble of detection techniques, reporting ~99.8% accuracy on the author's internal evaluation set, and is positioned as a probabilistic signal rather than a definitive classifier given how hard and adversarial general-purpose AI text detection is. A simple web demo and public API docs (no API keys required) are available.
mentions.problem: General-purpose AI text detection is hard and adversarial, so the tool provides probabilistic heuristic signals instead of a definitive classifier.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on an API that provides heuristic signals about whether a piece of text is likely LLM-generated.

The system uses an ensemble of techniques, and on my internal evaluation set (details below) it achieves ~99.8% accuracy. I’m fully aware that general-purpose AI text detection is hard and adversarial, so this is meant as a probabilistic signal rather than a definitive classifier.
